scopes.description: Produce all 18 additional analyses presented in the supplied online appendix. The document maps these tables to discussions in the paper but supplies only reported results, not an executable workflow or input lineage.

actions.description: Request the complete author workflow and compatible data materials needed to reproduce all 18 supplied appendix tables; do not independently reconstruct the underlying study inputs.
steps: Obtain the author-provided executable workflow or an explicitly approved alternative, with its entry point, required stage order, and required software/runtime details for Tables A1–A18.

Obtain compatible author-prepared analysis data or a complete input inventory and documented acquisition/build instructions specifying files, fields, identifiers, periods, formats, and producer-consumer steps.

Run the supplied workflow and compare the generated appendix tables with the reported results only under a separately authorized execution step.
